newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Food Lion cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Food Lion cut.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch has cut its rating for Food Lion Inc to near-term neutral from accumulate, a source at the brokerage said on Friday.
-- Merrill Lynch kept the company's rating of long-term accumulate.
-- Shares in the company opened down 1-1/16 at seven.
-- J.P. Morgan Securities analysts Mark Husson and Sandhya Raju also reduced their rating for Food Lion to market underperformer from performer.

"First quarter EPS have come in $0.01 lighter than our $0.11 forecast, having hit the two bumps in the road that we highlighted as potential problems in our recent coverage-initiated note published on Feb 11.

-- "Difficult Kash N Karry integration and slowing comps (comparable store sales) will take time to recover from and until there is evidence this is happening, we are reducing our recommendation ...."
